title: 蟠桃园的请帖
subtitle: 想被看见，也要好好开口
origin: 《西游记》第五回（低龄温和改编）

moral.zh: 感到被忽略时，可以把失落说出来；未经同意拿取或打乱东西，只会让误会变得更大。
moral.en: When we feel left out, we can say so. Taking or disrupting things without permission only makes misunderstandings grow.

pages.zh: 悟空来到蟠桃园帮忙照看桃树，每天给树根松土、为嫩枝挡风。
pages.en: Wukong helped care for the Peach Garden, loosening soil around roots and shielding young branches from wind.
pages.prompt: Sun Wukong in golden-yellow tunic and dark red trousers, still without a headband, gently tends glowing peach trees using a small rounded wooden garden tool; celestial garden helpers nearby, no text.

pages.zh: 花会快到了，仙女们忙着整理果篮和请帖。悟空却一直没等到自己的那一份。
pages.en: As the festival approached, celestial attendants prepared fruit baskets and invitations, but Wukong never received one.
pages.prompt: Celestial attendants in soft pastel ancient robes sort peach baskets and blank gold invitation cards while Wukong waits at a respectful distance, looking puzzled rather than angry; no readable writing or text.

pages.zh: 他越想越委屈，伸手摘下一只桃子，又悄悄把几张请帖换了位置。
pages.en: Feeling more and more hurt, he picked one peach and quietly moved several invitation cards.
pages.prompt: Wukong pauses with one peach in hand beside several displaced blank invitation cards, his expression conflicted and regretful; no eating, no medicine, no text.

pages.zh: 结果，织云仙子收到了采露仙子的请帖，守门人也找不到该送往哪座云宫。
pages.en: Then the cloud weaver received the dew gatherer's invitation, and the gatekeeper could no longer tell where the cards belonged.
pages.prompt: Friendly celestial attendants compare mismatched blank cards marked only with simple cloud and dew-drop pictures, while a gatekeeper studies mixed baskets; gentle confusion, no text.

pages.zh: 王母娘娘没有责怪悟空，只问：“你真正想要的，是桃子，还是被大家记得？”
pages.en: The Queen Mother did not scold Wukong. She asked, “Did you truly want a peach, or did you want to be remembered?”
pages.prompt: The Queen Mother, a kind mature woman with a warm oval face, silver-black hair in a high cloud bun, lavender-and-rose robes and a simple jade phoenix hairpin, speaks gently with seated Wukong beneath peach blossoms; no throne, no text.

pages.zh: 悟空低头承认：“我怕大家觉得我不重要，所以做了更让人困扰的事。”
pages.en: Wukong admitted, “I feared I did not matter, so I did something that troubled everyone even more.”
pages.prompt: Wukong honestly apologizes with open empty hands to the Queen Mother and celestial attendants; peach and invitation cards remain safely on a low table, compassionate expressions, no text.

pages.zh: 大家一起按图案把请帖重新分类，也补上一张邀请悟空参加园艺分享会的新卡片。
pages.en: Together they sorted the invitations by picture, and made a new card inviting Wukong to share what he had learned in the garden.
pages.prompt: Wukong and attendants cooperatively sort blank picture cards into cloud, flower, and water-drop baskets; one new card shows only a peach-tree icon, no readable text.

pages.zh: 花会那天，悟空讲起怎样照顾桃树。原来好好开口，比偷偷拿一只桃子更能让人听见。
pages.en: At the festival, Wukong shared how to care for peach trees. Speaking honestly helped others hear him far better than taking a peach in secret.
pages.prompt: Wukong happily demonstrates gentle peach-tree care at an inclusive celestial garden gathering while Queen Mother and attendants listen; shared fruit stays in baskets, festive but calm, no text.
